entrance.name: Main Entrance
entrance.description: The main entrance with battered shopping carts. The automatic doors squeak with every passerby.

produce_section.name: Produce Section
produce_section.description: Colorful but slightly wilted displays. The floor is slippery due to a crushed grape.

meat_counter.name: Meat Counter
meat_counter.description: Pink neon lights illuminate vacuum-sealed cuts of beef. It is freezing cold here.

fish_counter.name: Fish Counter
fish_counter.description: A strong smell of iodine and melted ice fills the air. The crabs seem to be judging you.

cleaning_products.name: Cleaning Products Aisle
cleaning_products.description: The air is thick with the chemical scent of bleach and synthetic lavender. The freshly mopped floor is dangerously shiny.

pastries.name: Pastry Section
pastries.description: The smell of warm butter tries to soften the mood. Crumbs cover the tiled floor.

clothing_aisle.name: Clothing Aisle
clothing_aisle.description: Bargain bins overflowing with discounted socks. It is absolute textile chaos.

smelly_mackerel.name: Smelly Mackerel
smelly_mackerel.description: A not-so-fresh fish, perfect for attracting felines.

premium_steak.name: Premium Steak
premium_steak.description: Rich in iron, perfect for regaining strength.

toxic_bleach.name: Bleach Jug
toxic_bleach.description: A highly corrosive product, formidable in combat.

stale_baguette.name: Stale Baguette
stale_baguette.description: As hard as oak. Makes for an excellent blunt weapon.

plastic_hanger.name: Plastic Hanger
plastic_hanger.description: A flimsy plastic hanger. It bends easily but makes a decent starting weapon.

cat_lady_agnes.name: Cat Lady Agnes
cat_lady_agnes.description: A customer desperately looking for something to feed her feral colony.
dialogue: My sweet little babies are so hungry...
Go fetch me a nice fish from the seafood counter, and I will reward you!

cleaner_claude.name: Claude the Janitor
cleaner_claude.description: He just mopped the floor and absolutely despises footprints.
dialogue: Don't step on the wet floor, I just mopped!

cashier_cindy.name: Cashier Cindy
cashier_cindy.description: Completely burned out, she is just waiting for her shift to end.
dialogue: Register closing in 2 minutes, please move to the next lane.

feed_the_cats.description: Find the Smelly Mackerel at the Fish Counter and bring it back to Agnes.

clean_the_cleaner.description: Defeat Claude in the Cleaning Products Aisle to get his bleach jug.
